author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at a rather serious situation that just won't stop escalating. AI systems have been so oversaturated everywhere that even the most sensitive parts of the worlds have them so deeply embedded it's made it's users lazy and let hallucinations that could end the world nearly slip by. How? Let's find out! Thanks for watching!
Like, Comment and Subscribe for more videos!
title: We Just Dodged World War 3...
